title: VDI Password Reset Authentication Policy (비밀번호 변경 후 VDI 로그인)
content: Synthetic IAM policy for Example Manufacturing. Repeated authentication failures may cause an AD account lock, including failures during VDI login after a password reset. IT Support may check account lock status. Only an authorized administrator may perform account modifications or privileged access changes. This decision-support platform must not modify accounts, unlock accounts, change privileges, or bypass authentication controls. This policy does not specify lockout thresholds or synchronization timing.
